page_title: WOL 2-0 EIN | Wolfsburg v Eintracht Frankfurt 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+4' Poor challenge! Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for tripping and Frank Willenborg blows his whistle.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Lovro Majer as he is replaced by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg).
90' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Jonas Wind is replaced by Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg).
89' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
89' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised.
87' A substitution has been made. Yannick Gerhardt goes off and Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) comes on.
84' 2 - 0 Goal! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
84' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Kevin Trapp leaps out to thwart his attempt.
84' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) is going to take the penalty!
84' Foul! Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
83' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) for Omar Marmoush.
83' It is time for a substitution. Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt) is on for Junior Dina Ebimbe.
83' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Paxten Aaronson (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Tuta.
79' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Tiago Tomas and he is replaced by Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) is coming onto the pitch as Mattias Svanberg cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post.
76' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but it's cleared.

76' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Kevin Trapp shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
73' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
71' Wolfsburg are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
68' Here comes a substitution. Fares Chaibi is given a rest as he is replaced by Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt).
67' The resulting corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
65' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) jumps into a tackle and Frank Willenborg signals a foul.
64' Kevin Trapp comes off his line to intercept the corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg).
61' A snap shot by Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Kevin Trapp produces a good save to thwart him.

61' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
60' Substitution. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Buta.
58' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
56' The referee awards a corner and Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes over to take it.
55' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
53' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
51' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Frank Willenborg stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

49' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Koen Casteels pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
47' The resulting corner, taken by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg), comes to nothing.
47' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
46' Referee Frank Willenborg blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
45+3' The free kick is delivered by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
45+2' The referee shows the yellow card to Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt).
45+1' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a huge opportunity after receiving a fine cross from the free kick, but his close-range shot goes well over the crossbar.
45+1' It seemed like Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
43' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner which is cleared.
43' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' That's a clear yellow card. Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes into the book.
40' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
39' Referee Frank Willenborg sees the trip by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
36' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
35' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

35' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Koen Casteels has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' The corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by the defence.
31' 1 - 0 Goal! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
31' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) but poses no threat.
28' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
24' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
24' The foul by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) was seen by Frank Willenborg who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
21' What a sweet touch by Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Koen Casteels to hold.
14' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
13' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
13' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul and Frank Willenborg immediately signals a free kick.
13' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
11' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
9' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
7' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar.
6' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

6' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) drifts into the box to meet the ball from the free kick and plants a header towards the bottom middle of the target. One of the defending players gets in its way and blocks it. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolfsburg.
5' It seemed like Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
5' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Wolfsburg are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
3' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
2' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
1' The match has just started.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick the game off.
Frank Willenborg will referee today's match.
